changelog:
v4.2.3 — 4K movie fix for generic Android TV boxes

• Fixed certain 4K movies showing a long black screen (up to ~2½ minutes) before finally erroring on Allwinner-based boxes (e.g. Pendoo X11 PRO) and similar generic 4K Android TV boxes. The app now recognizes 4K HDR titles its hardware can't decode and tells you right away — "This is a 4K HDR title — this device can't decode it. Try a 1080p or HD version" — instead of stalling.
• 4K titles that stall because of a slow connection no longer get worse: the player stops swapping to a slower decoder mid-stream and keeps the working one, recovering cleanly or telling you your connection is too slow for 4K.

Applies to all devices. Non-4K playback is unchanged.
